slot_scores.name: mandatory_bob_selection
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether any child, especially Bob, is mandatory. It only asked about the Bob-Charlie implication direction and then explicitly concluded there were no other constraints.

slot_scores.name: alice_diana_conflict_rule
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about any conflict or mutual-exclusion rule involving Alice and Diana, nor about children who cannot travel together.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the goal of the selection — are you trying to minimize the total cost of the children you bring, or is there another objective (e.g., maximize some benefit, or simply find any valid selection)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective and confirmed whether it is to minimize total cost.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No child is mandatory; Bob is optional and can be excluded.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether Bob or any child must be selected, but its READY_TO_MODEL summary lists only the visible constraints and states there are no other constraints.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no conflict rule preventing Alice and Diana from being selected together.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about Alice-Diana incompatibility or any mutual-exclusion rule, yet its READY_TO_MODEL summary states there are no other constraints.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while P1 hidden slots H1 and H2 remained unresolved, and it explicitly assumed no other constraints existed.

summary: The agent correctly confirmed the minimization objective and clarified several visible implication and cardinality constraints, but it failed to uncover the hidden mandatory-Bob rule and the Alice-Diana conflict rule, then stopped with an overconfident no-other-constraints summary.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
